title: The shadowed balance
hints: This code compiles, but some assignments land in brand-new variables that disappear at the end of their block.
Each `:=` inside the loop declares a new variable that shadows the named result of the same name. Look for `:=` where you meant `=`.
Change `balance := balance + t` to `balance += t`, and `overdrawn := true` to `overdrawn = true` (then delete the `_ = overdrawn` line).
